title: fix: generate request bodies in API docs
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds curated JSON request examples for timestamped speech, community provider profiles, and 3D generation.
- Fixes the API docs workflow failure where compact example synthesis emitted POST curls without request bodies.
- Keeps generated `APIDOCS.md` out of the feature PR.

Checks:
- `npx biome check --write gen.pollinations.ai/scripts/generate-apidocs.ts`
- `npx vitest run test/docs.test.ts`
- Live-schema `docs:generate` followed by `docs:validate`

gist.headline: POST bodies return home
gist.blurb: The docs gardener found a few POST examples trying to leave without their luggage. Curated JSON bodies now travel with timestamped speech, community profiles, and 3D generation requests.
gist.summary: Fixed API documentation generation so compact curl examples for timestamped speech, community provider profiles, and 3D generation include curated JSON POST request bodies.
gist.impact: Developers can now copy working request examples for these endpoints instead of reconstructing missing payloads by hand.
gist.visual_concept: Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, repairs a cozy API-docs garden where three labeled JSON parcels are being placed into POST envelopes beside a glowing retro terminal. Code-plants, small flowers, and the visible curl command represent generated documentation that is finally complete.
